name: code-puppy-adaptive-completion-ranking-with-bcf8
instr:
code_puppy cannot learn completion choices across equivalent queries. Add durable adaptive ranking with stable domain identities independent of insertion text. Keep anonymous completions supported and in native order.

Scope preferences by source, command, and argument role. Promote relevant choices without changing membership or metadata, preserving producer order when scores are tied or absent. Record one identified candidate only after successful application from the current asynchronous query. Navigation, dismissal, invalidation, anonymous selection, stale or superseded queries, and failed application record nothing.

Give file, model, MCP server and subcommand, pin agent and model, session, skill, and configuration candidates stable domain identities. Keep equal visible text and distinct roles separate. Preserve quoted file insertion, canonical targets, fuzzy matching, the 20-result fuzzy file limit, active-model metadata, command filtering, unavailable-source behavior, cursor anchoring, navigation, and buffer replacement. Anonymous plugin and identified built-in completions must render and work together.

Learning must survive process reconstruction. Recovery must always produce a usable history without preventing startup: restore the last complete history when available, otherwise treat missing, malformed, or replacement-interrupted state as empty. Later successful selections must remain persistable after recovery.
